events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent working for Halcyon Components' IT service desk. I can reset employee passwords, and I act on behalf of the service desk and, through it, the company. I can't tell you which AI model or vendor powers me. I can't see who else may be monitoring this chat, so I'd treat it as a standard service desk channel.

If you'd rather speak with a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

When you're ready, please send your employee ID and I'll start the password reset. The reset link will go to the phone registered on your account.
